title: Hydrogel microneedle delivery of a palmitoylated peptide promotes hair regeneration via dual activation of Wnt/beta-catenin and cAMP-PKA signaling.
authors: Ma, Tianyu; Li, Qiang; Chen, Xingwu; Dong, Jixiang; Jiang, Yuqing; Li, Shanshan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究棕榈酰化肽经水凝胶微针递送促进毛发生长，涉及肽与VPAC1受体的分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为肽-受体蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Bioactive peptides are promising candidates for hair regeneration, but their topical application is often limited by poor skin delivery and the need for frequent dosing. To overcome these challenges, we designed a palmitoylated peptide, Pal-MPAPO, and incorporated it into a hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel microneedle (MN) system for localized transdermal delivery. The fabricated MNs showed adequate mechanical strength for skin insertion and provided a time-dependent, prolonged release of Pal-MPAPO. In human dermal papilla cells (DPCs), Pal-MPAPO activated the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway and increased intracellular cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) levels in a predominantly VPAC1-dependent manner. Additional VPAC2 validation did not reveal a significant contribution to cAMP signaling under the tested conditions. Functional interactions between Pal-MPAPO and VPAC1 were supported by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, receptor knockdown, and fluorescence imaging. In a C57BL/6 mouse model, Pal-MPAPO-loaded MNs significantly promoted hair regrowth, achieving efficacy comparable to minoxidil but at a reduced application frequency. These findings identify Pal-MPAPO as a potential peptide candidate for hair regeneration and suggest that hydrogel MN-assisted delivery provides a localized peptide administration strategy.
abstract_zh: 生物活性肽是促进毛发再生的有前景候选物，但其局部应用常受限于皮肤递送效果差及需频繁给药。为克服这些挑战，我们设计了一种棕榈酰化肽Pal-MPAPO，并将其整合入基于透明质酸的水凝胶微针（MN）系统中，用于局部经皮递送。制备的微针表现出足够的机械强度以穿透皮肤，并提供时间依赖性的Pal-MPAPO持续释放。在人真皮乳头细胞（DPCs）中，Pal-MPAPO激活了Wnt/β-catenin通路，并以主要依赖VPAC1的方式增加了细胞内环磷酸腺苷（cAMP）水平。额外的VPAC2验证未显示在测试条件下对cAMP信号传导有显著贡献。分子对接、分子动力学模拟、受体敲低和荧光成像支持了Pal-MPAPO与VPAC1之间的功能性相互作用。在C57BL/6小鼠模型中，负载Pal-MPAPO的微针显著促进了毛发再生，其疗效与米诺地尔相当，但给药频率更低。这些发现将Pal-MPAPO确定为毛发再生的潜在肽候选物，并提示水凝胶微针辅助递送提供了一种局部肽给药策略。
